tools.name: create_wakeup
tools.description: Schedule a webhook call at a future time (one-shot). Your agent can die; the call still happens.

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Recurring webhook on a cron expression (at most every 15 minutes), for up to 30 days, renewable for free.

tools.name: create_deadman
tools.description: Dead-man switch: if you stop checking in, we fire your alert webhook.

tools.name: checkin_deadman
tools.description: Check in to a dead-man switch so it does not fire.

tools.name: delayed_delivery
tools.description: Hand over a payload now; we POST it to the target at a future moment.

tools.name: notarize
tools.description: Signed proof that a hash (or your data) existed at this moment.

tools.name: attested_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return content plus a signed receipt binding url, status, content hash and time.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Public URL that buffers inbound webhooks until you collect them.

tools.name: create_bin
tools.description: Request bin: a public URL that captures every request in full (method, headers, body) for debugging webhooks. Watch it live at https://api.zenvault.eu/view.

tools.name: collect_messages
tools.description: Collect buffered messages from an inbox or bin.

tools.name: guaranteed_delivery
tools.description: POST a payload to a URL, retried with backoff until it succeeds.

tools.name: create_vault
tools.description: Create a key-value namespace with TTL that survives your runs.

tools.name: kv_set
tools.description: Store a value in a vault (max 64 KB, last 10 versions kept).

tools.name: kv_get
tools.description: Read a value from a vault.

tools.name: kv_list
tools.description: List keys in a vault.

tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.description: Save run state so you can resume after a crash.

tools.name: create_checkpoint
tools.description: Create a crash checkpoint store.

tools.name: load_checkpoint
tools.description: Load the latest saved checkpoint state.

tools.name: store_secret
tools.description: Store a value that self-destructs on first read; returns a one-time read URL.

tools.name: create_queue
tools.description: Pull-based work queue with leases; timed-out leases requeue.

tools.name: queue_push
tools.description: Push a job onto a queue.

tools.name: queue_lease
tools.description: Lease the next job from a queue.

tools.name: queue_ack
tools.description: Acknowledge (or nack) a leased job.

tools.name: create_counter
tools.description: Create an atomic counter.

tools.name: counter_incr
tools.description: Increment a counter atomically.

tools.name: claim_operation
tools.description: Idempotency firewall: claim an operation id exactly once across runs.

tools.name: create_idempotency
tools.description: Create an idempotency/replay firewall.

tools.name: create_watch
tools.description: Watch something and fire your webhook when it changes. Types: change, keyword, regex, structured, drift, redirect, sitemap, staleness, rss, dns, port, cert, heartbeat.

tools.name: watch_status
tools.description: Check a watch: last value, checks, fires.

tools.name: create_escalation
tools.description: Escalation chain: webhook, then after N seconds the next step, until acknowledged.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Status of any resource you hold the management token for.

tools.name: extend_resource
tools.description: Extend a resource lifetime, free, up to 30 days ahead.

tools.name: cancel_resource
tools.description: Cancel a resource early.

tools.name: export_resource
tools.description: Export everything under a resource before it expires.

tools.name: list_prices
tools.description: Free-tier limits: what is free (everything) and the per-IP caps.

tools.name: request_feature
tools.description: Tell the operator what ZenVault is missing. Free.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "store_secret" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Store a value that self-destructs on first read; returns a one-time read URL.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: attested_fetch, create_bin, store_secret · Private data: create_vault, kv_set, kv_get, kv_list, store_secret, get_resource · Public sink: create_wakeup, create_schedule, create_deadman, delayed_delivery, guaranteed_delivery, create_watch, create_escalation · Destructive: save_checkpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: attested_fetch, create_bin, store_secret · Private data: create_vault, kv_set, kv_get, kv_list, store_secret, get_resource · Public sink: create_wakeup, create_schedule, create_deadman, delayed_delivery, guaranteed_delivery, create_watch, create_escalation · Destructive: save_checkpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_schedule" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Recurring webhook on a cron expression until the prepaid days run out." → after: "Recurring webhook on a cron expression (at most every 15 minutes), for up to 30 days, renewable for free."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
